themes_detail.label: Street noise surge
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints spiked to 53 THIS WEEK, a 145% jump from the 8-week average of 21.6 weekly complaints (z-score: 3.99), suggesting a sharp, sudden escalation in outdoor disturbances across St. George/Stapleton.
evidence: 53 street/sidewalk noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 21.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
No offsetting decline in other noise categories; isolated to street/sidewalk domain
reporting_angles: What construction or street activity launched this week that triggered the complaints?
Interview residents on specific blocks with highest noise concentration; map complaint geography

themes_detail.label: Overgrown trees accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree and branch complaints jumped to 14 THIS WEEK, a 124% increase from the 8-week average of 6.2 per week (z-score: 4.18), indicating rapid deterioration of tree maintenance or storm damage across the district.
evidence: 14 overgrown tree/branch complaints THIS WEEK vs. 6.2 weekly baseline
124% spike with z-score of 4.18 indicates significant statistical departure
Timing may correlate with recent weather events or seasonal growth
reporting_angles: Was there a recent storm or weather event that caused branch damage?
Interview Parks Dept on tree maintenance backlog in CD501; map complaint locations

themes_detail.label: Street sign damage epidemic
themes_detail.summary: Damaged and missing street signs surged last week: 6 damaged sign complaints (336% above 8-week avg of 1.4) and 5 missing sign complaints (300% above avg of 1.2), totaling an unusual 11-sign problem in a single week with z-scores of 4.66 and 4.52.
evidence: 6 damaged street signs LAST WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average (336% spike, z-score 4.66)
5 missing street signs LAST WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly average (300% spike, z-score 4.52)
Combined 11-sign problem in one week suggests concentrated infrastructure failure
reporting_angles: Was there a traffic accident, storm, or vandalism incident affecting signs?
Check DOT records for any street work or vehicle incidents in CD501 last week

themes_detail.label: Construction complaints rising
themes_detail.summary: General construction and plumbing complaints jumped to 29 last week, an 84% increase from the 8-week average of 15.8 per week (z-score: 3.96), correlating with 124 new building permits and 439 alteration filings filed over the past 90 days in the district.
evidence: 29 construction/plumbing complaints LAST WEEK vs. 15.8 weekly baseline (84% increase, z-score 3.96)
641 total DOB permits filed in last 90 days: 124 new buildings, 439 alterations, 11 demolitions
Multiple active ULURP and non-ULURP development applications in review pipeline
reporting_angles: Which new construction or alteration projects are generating the most complaints?
Interview DOB on permit compliance and noise mitigation requirements for active sites

themes_detail.label: Lot condition deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Lot condition complaints peaked at 7 three weeks ago, a 1020% spike from the 8-week average of 0.6 per week (z-score: 9.16, the district's highest anomaly), though signal has cooled since; worth investigating whether issue was resolved or reporters stopped complaining.
evidence: 7 lot condition complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.6 weekly average (1020% spike, highest z-score: 9.16)
Spike has not recurred in past 2 weeks, suggesting either remediation or reporting drop-off
11 full demolitions filed in past 90 days may indicate lot vacancy and abandonment issues
reporting_angles: Identify the specific lots that triggered complaints 3 weeks ago; have they been cleaned or demolished?
Cross-reference abandoned vehicle complaints (696 over 90 days) with lot condition spikes
